free_tier.stated: 30 GB per uploaded video file, with no documented community-level storage cap. Course/lesson file attachments are separate and much smaller (images 413 above ~10 MB).

egress.terms: Free/unmetered playback from Skool's CDN. Private files on `assets.skool.com` return 403 and get signed URLs minted on download, so the read path is not a public CDN.

tooling: No official API. A community reverse-engineering effort exists (skool-api.cristiantala.com) using playwright + Google's Browserless actor with cookie auth; the `files:uploadImage` actor is documented empirically, not by Skool.
chaining: N free communities? No — Skool is $9/mo hobby or $99/mo pro after a 14-day trial, so the multiplier is paid seats, which fails the 'free' premise.
limits_note: 30 GB per video file; ~10 MB per image; uploads only through the web/mobile UI; private assets require on-demand signed URLs.
reliability_note: Not free and not programmatic. Recorded here only because 30 GB/file is the largest per-file ceiling in this entire niche and worth knowing as a comparison point.

evidence.proved: 'Skool accepts up to ~10 MB per image (empirically — not documented). Above that, the upload returns a 413.'; 'assets.skool.com/... URLs for private files return 403'
